name: Vocal Remover
description: Ultimate Vocal Remover's MDX-Net separation, running entirely in the sandbox. Give it a song and it gives you back the singing and the backing as separate files — and, if you ask, splits the vocal again into lead and backing. It is SLOW: the model listens in six-second pieces, and on the processor alone that is roughly ten times the length of the track (measured), so a four-minute song is most of an hour. A device with a GPU is much faster. The app measures the real rate as it goes, shows what is left and can be stopped, and offers a 30-second try first. UVR's own model weights arrive the first time you separate (hash-pinned, only the models that job needs) and stay on this computer. Nothing is ever uploaded — the app has no network of its own. Overlap, denoise and invert-spec start at UVR's shipped defaults.
